items.html: It is written in Idrat Nasso, p 131b, “Some were perfumed and some were not perfumed.” This does not mean that there are some kings among them that were perfumed and some that were not perfumed. Rather, it means actually some of them, a part of the kings themselves, from each and every part of each of them, some of it was sorted and perfumed, and a part of them, from each and every one in them, was not perfumed and remained below.
